# useCounter

> A number with `min`/`max` clamping, a `step`, `set` and `reset`.

🟢 beginner · React 16.8+ · Custom Hooks › State utilities · support: universal

**Playground:** `npm run dev` → [`#/entry/use-counter`](http://localhost:5173/#/entry/use-counter)

## Concept

Keeps a number in state and clamps every update to `[min, max]`. The rendered `count` is clamped as well, so narrowing the bounds never shows an out-of-range value.

## Problem

Bounds checks spread across buttons and inputs drift apart; non-functional updates lose increments when several happen in one event.

## When to use

- Quantity steppers, pagination, ratings, zoom levels.

## When not to use

- Free-form numeric input: keep the raw text in state (users type `-`, `1.`, empty) and validate it — the demo does exactly that for its bound inputs.

## API

```ts
function useCounter(
  initialValue?: number,
  options?: { min?: number; max?: number; step?: number },
): {
  count: number;
  increment(): void;
  decrement(): void;
  set(next: number | ((n: number) => number)): void;
  reset(): void;
  isAtMin: boolean;
  isAtMax: boolean;
};
```

| Parameter                        | Type     | Description                              |
| -------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `initialValue` _(optional)_      | `number` | Default `0`; clamped.                    |
| `options.min / max` _(optional)_ | `number` | Inclusive bounds (default ±Infinity).    |
| `options.step` _(optional)_      | `number` | Used by increment/decrement (default 1). |

**Returns:** The clamped `count`, actions (stable while the options are unchanged) and bound flags for disabling buttons.

## Edge cases

- `set(NaN)` (or an updater returning `NaN`) is ignored.
- `min > max` throws a `RangeError` during render — a programming error.
- `reset()` returns to the first-render initial value, clamped to the current bounds.
